r.경제 체제: Economy tied to South Africa · sugar
r.주식시장 시가총액: $234.3 million, 7% of GDP (2007, listed domestic companies)
r.주요 수출품: Cosmetics, fragrances 28%, Sugar 23%, Other chemicals 14%, Clothing (woven) 7%, Wood 6% (2023, share of all exports, top 5)
r.한국이 파는 것: Electronics, electrical equipment 37%, Steel products 27%, Precision and medical instruments 13%, Machinery, computers 10% (2025, share of value)

t.why: The only African country that still recognizes Taiwan.
t.rel: A landlocked country between South Africa and Mozambique that uses its own currency alongside the South African rand and is in a customs union with South Africa. Most of its trade passes through South Africa.
t.know: In 2018 it changed its name from Swaziland to Eswatini.
t.etext: It sells sugar and soft-drink concentrate and depends heavily on the South African economy. Its currency is pegged to the South African rand.
